pin_regs.reason: Generated wires-only parent of the static join: every tile <-> tile / die-master hop is priced in the compiled join ages with the die relays only (kv_relays, die_ages.json); a recipe-3 pin register would add an unpriced edge to every crossing.  The children land / launch their boundary nets in their own flops.

structural_change: KV-BOOTAGE 10-19 (coordinator decision, lanes/KVR-DERIVE.md re-harden spec): the attention tile with BOOT-PROGRAMMABLE static-schedule ages: attn_root qkd_attn_service_root_b (PV_LEAD; END = PV_START + LAST + 47 + F_DLY), attn_face qkd_attn_result_face_sb (F_DLY), attn_cal qkd_attn_cal_gen_b (D_QK, D_RL, F_DLY: R = SERVICE_END - 48 - F_DLY - PV_START keeps RESULT_AGE on the link slot) from the sealed die cfg word {D_RL, D_QK, F_DLY, PV_LEAD} riding the ctl -> attn bundle (i_ctl 77 -> 109 b; static, no handshake). Same face landing as fl1 (rst_n +3 release, fin +1, i_ctl +1), wrapper rtl/lib/face_land/qkd_kvs_attn_fl_ba.sv. Die-derived PV_LEAD 37 / F_DLY 49 / D_QK 57 vs the closed tile 0 / 1 / 28. Lockstep vs the closed modules: results/rtl/kv_bootage_1019. NEW kit (RTL-BUILD-KV M1, KV-INTEG/KITS-A): generated static tile qkd_kvs_attn of the KV die (5 children: qkd_attn_cal_gen, qkd_attn_fault_root, qkd_attn_result_face_s, qkd_attn_service_root, qkd_native_attention_programme; hard: none), from rtl/qwen_sys/static_kv_die_20261017/qkd_kvs_tiles_hroot_ff_k.sv (sha256 77831bc28446) by tools/qwen_kv_die/kvs_tile_kits.py; one clock port ck (OT_KV_TILE_KITS).  Faces {'S': 1546, 'N': 1080, 'E': 626} pins on 302.4 x 302.4 um (die frame record (302.4, 302.4) ASSUMED -> this outline for KV-PLAN3).; HKV-RSTCAP fl1 10-19: closed g3 native capture 383.3 ps > 190 on 58 pins: rst_n 383.3 (async clear of every child), fin[0] 372.4 (pvfin stream valid fan-out), i_ctl[2]/[0] 338.0/334.2 (issue / capability enables of the 400-b command capture), fin data bits 190-224 (pin -> far first flop). Shared face landing standard (tools/ref_tile/face_land.py, spec face_land): top qkd_kvs_attn_fl = generated wrapper, rst_n drives only ot_rst_relay (async assert, release +3 edges, zero steady-state cycles) + landed buses fin +1 edge, i_ctl +1 edge (rtl/lib/ot_pin_land.sv, one capture flop per bit at the face, anchored by io_flop_at_pins); core RTL unchanged. Die: rebind qkd_kvs_attn -> qkd_kvs_attn_fl, startup waits +3 edges, schedule prices fin +1, i_ctl +1 (lanes/HKV-RSTCAP.md). | KV-RELAYGEN 10-19 (SAFE-AUDIT-KV item 3/7, results/arch/safe_audit_1019/kv.md): gate ba1: the face-land rst_n relay drove 1,221 flops on one copy -> the wrapper rtl/lib/face_land/qkd_kvs_attn_fl_ba.sv is regenerated (face_land.wrapper reset_copies rst_n 8; copies=1 regen proven byte-identical) and reset_relay_split {256} spreads the core's reset loads over the 8 KEPT copies (pre-optimisation loads run 1.4-2.9x the final 1,221 on the prompt tile) in synthesis; release +3 unchanged. | ba3 structural redesign after b1 final TT -105.22 and b2 gate TT -40: move 493/507-bit record zero reductions into <=32-bit flags captured at the EXISTING RX landing edge. Combine registered flags in the next stage instead of reducing 500 landed data bits through request_valid/fault into root calendar enables. All token-cycle, fault and valid edges preserved; old closed RTL untouched. Eight reset copies retained.

reroute_reason.fix: input side: rst_n lands in ot_rst_relay (2 sync + 1 kept relay flop) so the pin has 3 flop sinks instead of the tile-wide async clear, and fin, i_ctl land in one face capture flop per bit (ot_pin_land, io_flop_at_pins anchors them at the pin); same outline / pin faces, core RTL unchanged
